measured: Application calls and optional settings are recorded below at the cited commits.

applications.name: volter-ai/browser-substrate (Substrate)
applications.client: @prisma/adapter-planetscale 6.19.1 over @planetscale/database 1.19.0 (package.json:110-111, resolved in package-lock.json), loaded from the project in the tab by Substrate's Prisma client stand-in

backend.call: Prisma's client-engine build in a tab, its adapter @prisma/adapter-planetscale over @planetscale/database's Client({ url, fetch }) at PLANETSCALE_DATABASE_URL: every query of the project's Prisma client (reads, writes, interactive and batch transactions) sent as SQL

@planetscale/database's connect({ url }).execute(sql, args) at PLANETSCALE_DATABASE_URL: the redirect middleware's link lookup and the API routes' and crons' SQL (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE over Dub's tables)
Prisma's edge client through @prisma/adapter-planetscale over @planetscale/database's Client: every edge Prisma query (reads, writes, transactions) sent as SQL
Dub's Prisma client (`new PrismaClient()`, no adapter of its own), given @prisma/adapter-planetscale by the World's injector: every server query and $transaction, from the first at boot

reaches: the dashboard: a branch password's host and credentials (the credentialDoor fills PLANETSCALE_DATABASE_URL)

applications.name: Twin (twin-world's own callers)
applications.client: the runtime's boot (packages/world-runtime), posting the descriptor's credentialDoor

backend.call: the runtime asks a World's planetscale twin for the application's connection string at boot (the descriptor's credentialDoor: POST /_twin/app-credentials), filling PLANETSCALE_DATABASE_URL

the trigger-backup cron (vercel.json, four times a day): POST https://api.planetscale.com/v1/organizations/dub/databases/dub/branches/main/backups { name, retention_value: 7, retention_unit: 'day' } with a service token (Authorization: <id>:<token>), failing on any answer but 2xx

applications.name: dubinc/dub
applications.gate: The shipped scheduled backup cron calls PlanetScale and rejects missing credentials; this is not an opt-in switch (apps/web/app/(ee)/api/cron/trigger-backup/route.ts:7-22).
